scopeNote: Covers the District of Columbia. DC has no county layer; the District issues all building permits directly.

permits.coverage: District of Columbia building permits issued in 2026, about 27,000 records. DC publishes one layer per calendar year back to 2009; earlier years are not searchable here.

source.name: DC GIS (DCRA feeds)
source.currentRecordsNote: Permits are published by the DC Department of Buildings via the DCRA feed service.
